links.outcome: In-hospital mortality, length of stay, sepsis and ICU transfer with vs without AI early warning system
links.effect: Intervention had 35.6% decreased risk of death (aHR 0.644), 11.2% decreased LOS, 7.5% decreased sepsis risk, and 24.9% increased unanticipated ICU transfer (aHR 1.249) versus usual care.
links.quote: A hospital-wide EWS based on nursing surveillance patterns decreased in-hospital mortality, sepsis, and LOS when integrated into the care team’s EHR workflow.

screen.reason: This is a multisite pragmatic cluster-randomized trial evaluating the clinical impact of deploying an ML-based early warning system (CONCERN EWS) vs usual care, rather than comparing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
